Contributor: infeeeee Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Hello! In the wikidata key the the wikidata id of the monument itself should be added, e.g. here https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/2315294665 both the statue AND the subject of the statue has a separate wikidata pages. Just because a memorial doesn't have a wikidata page (yet), it does not mean we should reuse that tag for a different purpose. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:subject:wikidata It's called "subject" because a memorial is not necessarily commemorate a person, it can be anything else. Thanks! Have a good mapping! Date: 2025-08-04T20:17:42+02:00
